purpose: Three unresolved canonical target or duplicate-review cases; editorial options only, source KU and Master unchanged

records.issue: Original expression is an awkward standalone target; revised example naturally uses squirt some dish soap onto the sponge.
records.recommended_canonical_target: squirt dish soap onto a sponge
records.recommended_gloss_zh: 往海绵上挤一点洗洁精
records.recommended_example_en: Squirt some dish soap onto the sponge before scrubbing the pan.
records.recommended_example_zh: 刷锅之前，先往海绵上挤一点洗洁精。
records.option_if_identity_must_be_preserved: Retain source target as HOLD until authoritative evidence supports it; do not assert QA pass.

records.issue: Dishwasher mesh filters generally require removal/cleaning; empty is natural for a debris trap or canister with collected matter, not interchangeable with cleaning a filter.
records.recommended_example_en: Remove and clean the dishwasher filter as directed in the manual.
records.recommended_example_zh: 按照说明书拆下并清洁洗碗机滤网。

alternative_if_source_is_debris_trap.example_en: Empty the debris trap before cleaning the filter.
alternative_if_source_is_debris_trap.example_zh: 清洁滤网前，先倒空集污槽。
